name: Hajimete no Orusuban
original_name: はじめてのおるすばん
source:
Shiori and Saori are twins, and they have a secret crush on the "oniichan" that lives next door. Recently they developed an interest in H and have "oniichan" teach them various things.

When summer comes he is asked to look after the house and the girls by their mother. Since it is summer vacation, there is a lot of free time. How fun can house sitting become?

[Quoted and translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/201961/]Getchu[/url] and [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908114104/http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4131]a forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
双胞胎姐妹诗织与纱织暗恋着住在隔壁的“大哥哥”。最近两人对色色的事产生了好奇，便缠着“大哥哥”教她们各种各样的知识。

夏天到来时，姐妹俩的母亲拜托他帮忙看家并照看两个女儿。正值暑假，空闲时间多得是——这场看家之旅究竟会变得多有趣呢？

[摘译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/201961/]Getchu[/url]及Baldo的[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140908114104/http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4131]论坛帖子[/url]]
